meta.scope: Saudi Arabia Batch 2 — Oil production and exports, oil-revenue fiscal dominance, and Vision 2030 non-oil densification.

candidates.title: Crude oil production statistics
candidates.description: Official statistics on crude oil production. Production is managed under OPEC+ frameworks and remains the dominant real-sector and external-earnings activity; volumes fluctuate with quota and market policy.
candidates.notes: Core real-sector production node. Highest-centrality commodity for Saudi Arabia.

candidates.title: Crude oil export statistics
candidates.description: Official statistics on crude oil export volumes. Oil exports dominate merchandise exports and current-account credits.

candidates.title: Oil revenue and fiscal dependence statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on oil revenues as a share of total budget revenue. Oil remains the largest single revenue source, though non-oil revenue has risen under Vision 2030 fiscal reforms (VAT, fees, etc.).
candidates.notes: Core fiscal-oil nexus node. Non-oil revenue share is rising.

candidates.title: Vision 2030 non-oil GDP and diversification framing
candidates.description: Policy and statistical framing of Vision 2030 diversification. Non-oil GDP share has risen to around half or more of the economy in recent readings; private-sector and SME contributions are tracked as core success metrics.
candidates.notes: Highest-centrality diversification and policy densification node.

candidates.publisher: Derived from energy, finance and Vision 2030 sources
